subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open linked fork PR for this GitHub Copilot auth-order fix?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open conflicting fork PR already uses closing syntax for this issue, so automation should not create a competing fix lane until maintainers choose the candidate path.

options.title: Adopt or replace linked fix
options.body: Review the fork PR, then either refresh/adopt it or close it and land an equivalent narrow fix in the main repository.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR while the contributor resolves conflicts and updates proof.
